taxable.name: Taxable brokerage
taxable.detail: Gains, interest and distributions are taxed as they come.

traditional.name: Tax-deferred
traditional.detail: Traditional IRA or 401(k): taxed as income on withdrawal.

growth.name: Growth, untouched for 10 years or more
growth.detail: Retirement that is still far off.

taxable: Taxes are not modelled. Stock index funds defer most of their gain until sold. The diversifiers are taxed harder: Treasury interest is ordinary income (free of state tax), funds holding gold bullion are taxed as collectibles, and funds that use futures pay out most of their return as taxable distributions.
The replay rebalances every month. In this account a sale can realise a gain.
traditional: Nothing is taxed until withdrawal, and withdrawals are taxed as ordinary income whatever was held. No holding is tax-favoured over another, and rebalancing costs no tax.
roth: Qualified withdrawals are untaxed. No holding is tax-favoured over another, and rebalancing costs no tax.
